articles.summary: IDEX Corporation (NYSE:IEX) announced today that it will release its fourth quarter 2026 results on Wednesday, February 4, 2026, prior to market open. An investor conference call and webcast will take place at 8:00 a.m. (CT) that same day with Chief Executive Officer and President Eric Ashleman and Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Sean Gillen. The event and associated earnings presentation will be available via webcast in listen-only mode on the Company's Investor Relations site
articles.title: IDEX Corporation to Webcast Fourth Quarter 2025 Earnings Call
